mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Area High School with a temperature of 71 degrees and a beautiful Waning Gibbous moon overhead.

September 2026 is officially Hunger Action Month in Verona. Mayor Luke Diaz has issued a proclamation recognizing that food insecurity impacts 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin, encouraging all of us to volunteer and donate to support local efforts like the Second Harvest Foodbank.

There is a lot happening in the community. Yoga at Insight Wellness is available today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can check out trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking back at our weekly recap, on August 23, a 17-year-old driver was cited for absolute sobriety and his passenger was cited for underage drinking.
We hope you are hungry because today's flavor of the day is the delightful Turtle Dove. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so you have plenty of time to head over and enjoy a treat.
